response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong TDD, systems, and full-stack skills, but his career is overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, and DLang rather than Java/Kotlin/JVM. He has minimal recent Java exposure (robotic arms tooling years ago) and no visible Kotlin, Spring, Hibernate, or IDE-internals experience, which are the core requirements for this role.
strengths: Deep, proven full-stack and systems engineering experience across many languages and domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated ability to build tooling/frameworks (test runners, assertion libraries, dev infra) showing tooling aptitude
concerns: No recent or substantial Java/Kotlin/JVM experience matching 'deep JVM understanding' requirement
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise application server experience
No direct IDE internals or language tooling experience beyond general dev tooling/CLI tools

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering craftsmanship and tooling-building background
